Joint probabilities of locally dependent item pairs

pairprobs.Rd

The within-class joint distribution of every item pair modelled with pairs in lca() (log-linear association within class). itemprobs() lists the paired items too, with the margins of these tables.

Usage

pairprobs(object)

Arguments

object

A model fitted with lca(..., pairs = ).

Value

A named list ("item1*item2") of arrays C1 x C2 x K: P(item1 = a, item2 = b | class k), each class slice summing to 1.

See also

itemprobs(), bvr(), lca() (pairs, association)

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 3, pairs = list(c(ace_emo_abuse, ace_phys_abuse)),
         association = "equal")
#> Starting Julia ...
pairprobs(m)[[1]][, , 1]     # 2 x 2 table of the pair in class 1
#>           0           1
#> 0 0.8884631 0.039645469
#> 1 0.0662971 0.005594321
# }
